Settings.Colour.Spectrum.Tip: Hue across, saturation down. Drag to change the color
Settings.Colour.AddToCustomColors.Tip: Keep this color in the next custom color box
Settings.Fonts.ForEveryThemeThe: For every theme. The theme's font is the one the theme names, or the usual one.
Settings.Fonts.UiSearch.Tip: Show only fonts whose name holds this
Settings.Fonts.UiList.Tip: The font for the app's text: buttons, lists and labels
Settings.Fonts.FixedOnly.Tip: List only fonts whose letters are all the same width, which keep NDF text lined up
Settings.Fonts.CodeList.Tip: The font for file names, values and the Editor
Settings.Fonts.RulesRunTopTo: Rules run top to bottom. Double-click a rule to open it.
Settings.Fonts.UseTheThemesFonts.Tip: Go back to the fonts the theme names
Settings.Fonts.Cancel.Tip: Keep the fonts as they were (Escape)
Settings.SettingsSearch.Tip: Show only the settings whose name or note holds this (Escape clears it)
Settings.KeepSourceComments.Note: Off: only comments written by rules are exported.
Settings.LineEndings.Note: The game's own files use LF.
Settings.FilesToExport.Note: All files: unchanged files and files with no rules are copied as they are. Slow and memory-heavy for large folders.
Settings.ConfirmBeforeRunExport.Note: Says how many files will be written, and where, before writing them.
Settings.ArmoryMarks.Note: A value your mod changes has a * after it, in the heading colour. Off: no *, and its tooltip still says what changed it.
Settings.ArmoryFileNames.Note: Under each value's name in the Unit and Weapon panes, the property the game's files keep it in, such as MaxSpeedInKmph.
Settings.AskExportFolder: Ask for the export folder each time
Settings.AskExportFolder.Note: Every Run export asks where to write the files, starting in the folder used last. Off: each file keeps the folder chosen for it.
Settings.BackUpOverwrittenFiles.Note: A file an export replaces is kept beside it first, as .bak.
Settings.OpenTheFolderAfter.Note: Opens the export folder in File Explorer when Run export finishes.
Settings.EditedWithEasyNDFComment.Note: First line of each edited file, with the version.
Settings.StampOff.Ask: Without this comment, EasyNDF cannot tell whether it has already edited a file, so it cannot warn you before it edits that file a second time. Turn it off anyway?
Settings.AddFolderLists.Note: Subfolders are included. The export zip keeps the folder structure.
Settings.FilesWithAPreset: Files a mod that is on has rules for
Settings.DuplicateFiles.Note: Same name and folder. Replace keeps the row's export folder.
Settings.WrapTextInLists.Note: File, Details, rule set and rule lists.
Settings.AutoFitFileList.Note: Resizing a column by hand overrides this until Reset column widths.
Settings.AutoAssignPresetsBy: Apply rule sets by file name
Settings.AutoAssignPresetsBy.Note: A rule set whose Applies To is "From its name" applies to the files whose whole name its name holds, capitals included. Off: rule sets apply only to the files they list.
Settings.ReopenTheLastFiles.Note: When the app starts, the file list comes back as it was left, with the files that are still where they were.
Settings.UndoSteps.Note: How many changes to rules and the file list Ctrl+Z can take back.
Settings.TextSize.Note: Ctrl+scroll in the text changes it too.
Settings.LineNumbersSwitch.Tip: Show line numbers beside the text
Settings.WordWrap.Note: Long lines wrap instead of scrolling sideways.
Settings.ScopeLines.Note: Thin lines down each level of indentation in the File Editor.
Settings.CloseBracketsAndQuotes.Note: Typing ( [ { " or ' also types its partner, with the cursor between them.
Settings.ShowEverythingInThe: Show everything in the descriptor tree
Settings.ShowEverythingInThe.Note: Off: a descriptor opens to the descriptors it names in other files, to show how files connect. On: also to its objects, lists and the descriptors it names in its own file.
Settings.ReopenTheLastFile.Note: When the app starts, the file last open in the File Editor opens again, where it was left.
Settings.Theme.Note: Colors and fonts. Automatic follows the system.
Settings.FontsButton.Tip: Choose the interface font and the code font
Settings.BeveledEdges.Note: Raised buttons and sunken boxes, in any theme.
Settings.InterfaceSize.Note: Makes everything in the window larger or smaller.
Settings.Tooltips.Note: The notes that appear when the mouse rests on a control.
Settings.SharpOnEveryMonitor.Note: Redraws the app for each monitor's scaling, so text stays sharp when the window moves to another monitor. Takes effect when EasyNDF restarts.
Settings.RememberTheWindow.Note: The window opens where it was, at the size it was.
Settings.TreadScrollbars.Note: A raised thumb with a grip, in a sunken track, in any theme.
Settings.PanesGrowWithThe.Note: Details and Descriptors keep their share of the window as it is resized. Off, they keep the size they were dragged to.
Settings.ColumnWidths.Note: Drag the line between two headings to resize. Widths are saved per table.
Settings.OneFileWithAll.Note: One file with all your mods, to keep or move to another computer.
Settings.BackUpAllMods.Tip: Save all mods as one file
Settings.RestoreBackup.Tip: Load a backup of all mods
Settings.ResetSettingsKeepsYour.Note: Reset settings keeps your mods. Clear all data deletes everything EasyNDF has saved.
Settings.Designer.NewFromThisTheme.Tip: Make an editable copy of the current theme
Settings.Designer.Reset.Tip: Reset the colors to the original theme
Settings.Designer.Export.Tip: Save your theme as a file to share
Settings.Preview.AHeadingInThe: A Heading in the Accent Color
Settings.Preview.AMuchLongerChoice: A much longer choice, to show how a wide entry looks
Settings.LanguageChoice.Note: Text a language does not cover yet shows in English. File contents and property names are never translated.
Settings.LanguagePacks.Note: To translate: Export, fill in each "text" in the file, then Import it.
Settings.ImportLanguage.Title: Import language pack
Settings.ExportLanguage.Tip: Save the language in use as a file to translate. For English, a blank pack
Settings.ExportLanguage.Title: Export language pack
Settings.RemoveLanguage.Tip: Remove the language pack you imported for this language
Settings.LanguageNotImported: The language pack could not be imported. {reason}
Settings.LanguageNotExported: The language pack could not be saved. {reason}
Settings.CapRow.Note: 0 to 20000. Limits the before and after list in Details, not the edits made. 0 hides the list.
Settings.CapRow.Refused: Enter a whole number from 0 to 20000. Still {before}.
Settings.DecimalsRow.Note: The maximum decimal places that Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide and Scale write into one value. 0 for no limit.
Settings.DecimalsRow.Refused: Enter a whole number from 0 to 12.
Settings.ThemeChoice.Automatic: Automatic (Paper or Slate, following the system)
Settings.Backup.NoPresets: No rule sets to back up.
Settings.Backup.NotSaved: The backup could not be saved. {reason}
Settings.Restore.Title: Restore backup
Settings.Reset.Ask: Put every setting back to how it was at first, including the theme and language? Your mods, rules and files are kept. Undo does not cover settings.
Settings.Clear.Ask: Delete every mod, rule set, property scan and setting EasyNDF has saved, and empty the file list? This cannot be undone. Back up your mods first if you want to keep them. Files on disk are not touched.
Settings.DataNote.Folder: Mods, scans and settings are kept in {folder}.
Settings.DataNote.InMemory: Mods, scans and settings are kept in memory only.
Settings.ThemeColour.Hover: Item under the mouse in a dropdown or menu
Settings.ThemeColour.EditorKeyword: Editor: keywords such as export and is
Settings.ThemeColour.EditorKeyword.Row: Keywords such as export and is
Settings.ThemeColour.EditorConst: Editor: constants such as True and nil
Settings.ThemeColour.EditorConst.Row: Constants such as True and nil
Settings.Designer.BuiltInNote: Built-in themes cannot be edited. "New from this theme" makes an editable copy.
Settings.Designer.EditingNote: Editing "{name}". Changes apply and save at once.
Settings.Designer.NotAColour: That is not a color. Use six hex digits after a #, like #1c221e.
Settings.Designer.CouldNotSave: The theme could not be saved. {problem}
Settings.Designer.DeleteAsk: Delete your theme "{name}"? The app goes back to {theme}.
Settings.Designer.CouldNotDelete: The theme could not be deleted. {problem}
Settings.Designer.ResetAsk: Put every color of "{name}" back to those of {theme}?
Settings.Designer.Imported: Imported. Missing colors were taken from {theme}.
Settings.Preview.NotValid: Not exported: the result would not be a valid file
